bronk_idle.note: BRONK the dad: burly caveman, black spiky hair, big nose, stubble, orange hide tunic with black spots, one shoulder strap, big round belly, bare feet. Frame 1 breathes: belly wider, head 1px lower.

bronk_walk.note: walk cycle: contact/down/pass/up. Legs alternate, arms swing opposite, belly lags and bounces, hair shifts.

bronk_eat.note: holding a giant meat leg to his mouth, chomping. F0 leg up mouth open wide, F1 bite down cheeks bulging, F2 chew squashed, F3 head back swallowing. Messy: keep room for the engine to add crumb particles.

bronk_play.note: rocking out with a bone guitar across his chest, mouth open singing. F0 neutral, F1 strum arm down + lean back, F2 big strum + one leg up, F3 head thrown back howling.

bronk_shock.note: terrified: jaw dropped to chest, eyes huge white circles, arms up, hair standing up. F1 even more extreme.

bronk_drive.note: seated in the foot-powered car, gripping a steering bone, legs hidden below the sprite bottom, leaning forward. F1 leaning harder, hair back.

bronk_hurt.note: knocked back, eyes X-ed out, arms flailing.

vela_idle.note: VELA the mum: tall, big orange-red hair piled up, bone hairpin, single-strap leopard-spot dress (use pink/red ramp), strong arms, sandals. F1 breathes.

vela_walk.note: walk cycle, hair and dress hem swing.

vela_cook.note: stirring a stone pot with a huge bone spoon, one hand on hip. Arm circles across the 4 frames.

vela_cry.note: captured and yelling, arms reaching out, hair wild.

kid_a_idle.note: PEBBLE the son: small, wild brown hair, one-shoulder hide, bare feet, cheeky grin.

kid_a_eat.note: gnawing a small meat bone, face covered in sauce.

kid_b_idle.note: ROXY the daughter: pigtails tied with bone rings, teal hide dress, holding a pet lizard toy.

kid_b_eat.note: two-handed chomping on a rib, cheeks stuffed.

villager_idle.note: generic tribesman: brown hair, plain hide wrap, worried face.

villager2_idle.note: generic tribeswoman: dark hair in a bun, green hide wrap, carrying a basket.

elder_idle.note: village elder: white beard to the waist, bone-skull headdress, purple robe, leaning on a gnarled staff. F1 the staff taps.

brute_idle.note: enemy raider: bald with a bone nose-ring, war paint stripes, thick club over one shoulder, heavy gut, angry.

blaze_idle.note: BLAZE the flaming raptor, the villain: a raptor whose back, tail-tip and crest burn with real flame (fire ramp y z A B C). Body is charcoal-dark green with soot-black singed patches, a cracked stone collar with a broken chain, one eye scarred, permanent scowl. Fire flickers between the two frames.

blaze_walk.note: prowling walk, tail counterbalancing, flames trailing back.

blaze_roar.note: head thrown back, jaws wide, a gout of flame from the mouth, crest flames doubled in size.

blaze_boss.note: boss-scale BLAZE for the final fight: same design, far more detail, flames licking up the whole spine, glowing cracks across the hide, the broken chain whipping.

trex_idle.note: the T-REX: enormous, olive-green with a lighter belly, scarred snout, tiny arms, teeth visible even closed. Breathing.

trex_roar.note: jaws wide open, tongue and throat visible, head lowered toward the viewer.

mammoth_idle.note: woolly mammoth: shaggy red-brown coat in layered tufts, huge ivory tusks, small eye, trunk curled. Breathing.

mammoth_trader.note: the WANDERING MAMMOTH shopkeeper: same mammoth but loaded with trade goods - bundles, clay pots, a woven rug saddle, bones and gourds hanging off a frame strapped to its back, a little bone bell on the trunk.

mammoth_shower.note: mammoth standing with its trunk raised and curled forward, spraying water. F0 trunk down, F1 raising, F2 spraying hard, F3 dribbling. Draw the water from the trunk in the blue/teal ramp.

compy_idle.note: tiny pack raptor, olive green with a yellow throat, big dumb eye, twitchy.

dodo_idle.note: fat grey-blue dodo, enormous yellow beak, three tail feathers, permanently startled.

dodo_walk.note: waddle, body tipping side to side.

boar_idle.note: cave boar: bristly dark brown, upward tusks, small red eye, ridge of hair along the spine.

raptor_idle.note: classic raptor: teal-green with darker stripes, feathered crest and forearms, sickle claw raised.

ptero_fly.note: pterodactyl in flight, leathery tan wings, long crest, full flap cycle: wings up, mid, down, mid.

tricera_idle.note: triceratops: heavy tan-brown body, big bony frill with scalloped edge, three ivory horns, beak mouth.

lizard_idle.note: lava lizard: orange-red scaled body with glowing cracks, spiky back ridge, forked tongue.

tarblob_idle.note: living tar blob: near-black glossy ooze with two white eyes, constantly wobbling and dripping. All four frames differ.

stego_idle.note: stegosaurus: purple-grey body, two rows of tan back plates, spiked tail, tiny head.

tile_grass.note: lush grass, tufts and blades, two tones of green plus a dark base. MUST TILE SEAMLESSLY: the left column must continue into the right column and the top row into the bottom. No outline. Keep contrast low so characters read on top.

wall_stone.note: a block of village wall seen from the front: stacked stone with mortar lines, darker at the bottom. Tiles horizontally.

wall_ruin.note: the same wall, broken and crumbling, top edge jagged, cracks and missing blocks.

prop_rock.note: a boulder with facets and a mossy top.

prop_palm.note: palm tree: curved trunk with ring texture, fan of fronds, two coconuts.

prop_tree.note: broad jungle tree: thick trunk with roots, dense layered canopy with highlight clumps.

prop_deadtree.note: burnt dead tree, bare forked branches, charred black-grey.

prop_bones.note: a ribcage and scattered bones half-buried in the ground.

prop_skull.note: a huge dinosaur skull resting on the ground, empty eye sockets, teeth.

prop_totem.note: carved tribal totem pole: three stacked painted faces, feathers at the top.

prop_hut.note: stone-age hut: rounded boulder walls, thatched hide roof, dark doorway, smoke hole.

prop_hut_ruin.note: the same hut wrecked: roof collapsed and burnt, walls broken open, scorch marks, smoke stains.

prop_cave.note: cave mouth in a rock face, dark interior fading to black, stalactites.

prop_campfire.note: campfire: ring of stones, logs, animated flame across all 4 frames. Bright and warm.

prop_signpost.note: wooden signpost with a painted bone arrow.

prop_barrel.note: woven basket barrel with a hide lid.

prop_pot.note: round clay pot with a painted tribal band.

prop_tar.note: a bubbling tar pool, two frames of bubbles.

prop_egg.note: large speckled dinosaur egg in the sand.

prop_stage.note: a rough stone performance stage: slab top on pillars, hide banners.

prop_fog.note: a churning ball of black fog for mystery encounters, with a faint purple glow inside. All four frames differ.

car.note: the FLINTSTONE CAR: wooden frame with a hide canopy on two stone roller wheels, a log bumper, a bone steering stick. Wheels rotate across the 4 frames (spoke positions change).

house_wall.note: interior cave wall with tool marks and a hanging hide, tiles horizontally.

house_table.note: stone slab table on rock legs, with plates carved from shell.

house_bed.note: bed of furs on a stone ledge.

house_shelf.note: wall shelf with clay pots and a skull.

stove_pit.note: the cooking pit the raptor sits in: a stone hearth ring with a grill of bones above it, blackened.

shower_frame.note: the mammoth shower: a stone stall with a hide curtain rail and a wooden platform, open at the front so a mammoth trunk can hang over it.

meat_leg.note: a giant cooked T-rex drumstick: bone handle, glistening dark meat, a bite taken out.
